title: First visit: what to bring and what to expect
subtitle: How the first visit works, what to bring, what to expect, and how to make the most of your time.

sections.heading: Before you arrive
items: Previous x-rays (within the last 2 years) — we can review them and may not need to retake
List of current medications (including supplements and over-the-counter)
Your main concern in writing — 2-3 sentences is enough
Any prior treatment plans or estimates from other clinics (if you have them)
Payment method — cash, transfer, Pagopar, or Bancard POS

sections.heading: What we do at the first visit
items: Diagnostic x-rays if needed (digital, low radiation)
Written summary of findings with options
No treatment is performed at the first visit unless it's an emergency

sections.heading: After the first visit
items: You receive a written plan within 1-3 business days
Plan includes: options, prices, timeline, payment options
You decide when — or whether — to start
No follow-up pressure or upsell calls

sections.heading: What to bring if it's an emergency
items: If you have swelling + fever, go to the hospital emergency first
